server_arguments.name: tokenizer_path
server_arguments.label: tokenizer-path
server_arguments.desc: The path of the tokenizer.

server_arguments.name: tokenizer_mode
server_arguments.label: tokenizer-mode
server_arguments.desc: Tokenizer mode. 'auto' will use the fast tokenizer if available, and 'slow' will always use the slow tokenizer.

server_arguments.name: load_format
server_arguments.label: load-format
server_arguments.desc: The format of the model weights to load.

server_arguments.name: trust_remote_code
server_arguments.label: trust-remote-code
server_arguments.desc: Whether or not to allow for custom models defined on the Hub in their own modeling files.

server_arguments.name: dtype
server_arguments.label: dtype
server_arguments.desc: Data type for model weights and activations.

server_arguments.name: kv_cache_dtype
server_arguments.label: kv-cache-dtype
server_arguments.desc: Data type for kv cache storage.

server_arguments.name: quantization_param_path
server_arguments.label: quantization-param-path
server_arguments.desc: Path to the JSON file containing the KV cache scaling factors.

server_arguments.name: quantization
server_arguments.label: quantization
server_arguments.desc: The quantization method.

server_arguments.name: context_length
server_arguments.label: context-length
server_arguments.desc: The model's maximum context length.

server_arguments.name: chat_template
server_arguments.label: chat-template
server_arguments.desc: The buliltin chat template name or the path of the chat template file. If you do not specify a vision model’s --chat-template, the server uses Hugging Face’s default template, which only supports text. Visit: https://docs.sglang.ai/backend/openai_api_vision.html#Chat-Template for more information.

server_arguments.name: is_embedding
server_arguments.label: is-embedding
server_arguments.desc: Whether to use a CausalLM as an embedding model.

server_arguments.name: skip_tokenizer_init
server_arguments.label: skip-tokenizer-init
server_arguments.desc: If set, skip init tokenizer and pass input_ids in generate request

server_arguments.name: mem_fraction_static
server_arguments.label: mem-fraction-static
server_arguments.desc: The fraction of the memory used for static allocation.

server_arguments.name: max_running_requests
server_arguments.label: max-running-requests
server_arguments.desc: The maximum number of running requests.

server_arguments.name: max_total_tokens
server_arguments.label: max-total-tokens
server_arguments.desc: The maximum number of tokens in the memory pool.

server_arguments.name: chunked_prefill_size
server_arguments.label: chunked-prefill-size
server_arguments.desc: The maximum number of tokens in a chunk for the chunked prefill.

server_arguments.name: max_prefill_tokens
server_arguments.label: max-prefill-tokens
server_arguments.desc: The maximum number of tokens in a prefill batch.

server_arguments.name: schedule_policy
server_arguments.label: schedule-policy
server_arguments.desc: The scheduling policy of the requests.

server_arguments.name: schedule_conservativeness
server_arguments.label: schedule-conservativeness
server_arguments.desc: How conservative the schedule policy is.

server_arguments.name: cpu_offload_gb
server_arguments.label: cpu-offload-gb
server_arguments.desc: How many GBs of RAM to reserve for CPU offloading

server_arguments.name: prefill_only_one_req
server_arguments.label: prefill-only-one-req
server_arguments.desc: If true, we only prefill one request at one prefill batch

server_arguments.name: stream_interval
server_arguments.label: stream-interval
server_arguments.desc: The interval (or buffer size) for streaming in terms of the token length.

server_arguments.name: random_seed
server_arguments.label: random-seed
server_arguments.desc: The random seed.

server_arguments.name: constrained_json_whitespace_pattern
server_arguments.label: constrained-json-whitespace-pattern
server_arguments.desc: Regex pattern for syntactic whitespaces allowed in JSON constrained output.

server_arguments.name: watchdog_timeout
server_arguments.label: watchdog-timeout
server_arguments.desc: Set watchdog timeout in seconds.

server_arguments.name: dist_timeout
server_arguments.label: dist-timeout
server_arguments.desc: Set timeout for torch.distributed initialization.

server_arguments.name: log_requests
server_arguments.label: log-requests
server_arguments.desc: Log the inputs and outputs of all requests.

server_arguments.name: show_time_cost
server_arguments.label: show-time-cost
server_arguments.desc: Show time cost of custom marks.

server_arguments.name: decode_log_interval
server_arguments.label: decode-log-interval
server_arguments.desc: The log interval of decode batch.

server_arguments.name: enable_cache_report
server_arguments.label: enable-cache-report
server_arguments.desc: Return number of cached tokens in usage.prompt_tokens_details for each openai request.

server_arguments.name: max_loras_per_batch
server_arguments.label: max-loras-per-batch
server_arguments.desc: Maximum number of adapters for a running batch, include base-only request.

server_arguments.name: attention_backend
server_arguments.label: attention-backend
server_arguments.desc: Choose the kernels for attention layers.

server_arguments.name: sampling_backend
server_arguments.label: sampling-backend
server_arguments.desc: Choose the kernels for sampling layers.

server_arguments.name: grammar_backend
server_arguments.label: grammar-backend
server_arguments.desc: Choose the backend for grammar-guided decoding.

server_arguments.name: speculative_algorithm
server_arguments.label: speculative-algorithm
server_arguments.desc: Speculative algorithm.

server_arguments.name: speculative_num_steps
server_arguments.label: speculative-num-steps
server_arguments.desc: The number of steps sampled from draft model in Speculative Decoding.

server_arguments.name: speculative_eagle_topk
server_arguments.label: speculative-eagle-topk
server_arguments.desc: The number of token sampled from draft model in eagle2 each step.

server_arguments.name: speculative_num_draft_tokens
server_arguments.label: speculative-num-draft-tokens
server_arguments.desc: The number of token sampled from draft model in Speculative Decoding.

server_arguments.name: enable_double_sparsity
server_arguments.label: enable-double-sparsity
server_arguments.desc: Enable double sparsity attention

server_arguments.name: disable_radix_cache
server_arguments.label: disable-radix-cache
server_arguments.desc: Disable RadixAttention for prefix caching.

server_arguments.name: disable_jump_forward
server_arguments.label: disable-jump-forward
server_arguments.desc: Disable jump-forward for grammar-guided decoding.

server_arguments.name: disable_cuda_graph
server_arguments.label: disable-cuda-graph
server_arguments.desc: Disable cuda graph.

server_arguments.name: disable_cuda_graph_padding
server_arguments.label: disable-cuda-graph-padding
server_arguments.desc: Disable cuda graph when padding is needed.

server_arguments.name: enable_nccl_nvls
server_arguments.label: enable-nccl-nvls
server_arguments.desc: Enable NCCL NVLS for prefill heavy requests when available.

server_arguments.name: disable_outlines_disk_cache
server_arguments.label: disable-outlines-disk-cache
server_arguments.desc: Disable disk cache of outlines to avoid possible crashes.

server_arguments.name: disable_custom_all_reduce
server_arguments.label: disable-custom-all-reduce
server_arguments.desc: Disable the custom all-reduce kernel and fall back to NCCL.

server_arguments.name: disable_mla
server_arguments.label: disable-mla
server_arguments.desc: Disable Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) for DeepSeek models.

server_arguments.name: disable_overlap_schedule
server_arguments.label: disable-overlap-schedule
server_arguments.desc: Disable the overlap scheduler.

server_arguments.name: enable_mixed_chunk
server_arguments.label: enable-mixed-chunk
server_arguments.desc: Enabling mixing prefill and decode in a batch when using chunked prefill.

server_arguments.name: enable_dp_attention
server_arguments.label: enable-dp-attention
server_arguments.desc: Enabling data parallelism for attention and tensor parallelism for FFN.

server_arguments.name: enable_ep_moe
server_arguments.label: enable-ep-moe
server_arguments.desc: Enabling expert parallelism for moe.

server_arguments.name: enable_torch_compile
server_arguments.label: enable-torch-compile
server_arguments.desc: Optimize the model with torch.compile.

server_arguments.name: torch_compile_max_bs
server_arguments.label: torch-compile-max-bs
server_arguments.desc: Set the maximum batch size when using torch compile.

server_arguments.name: cuda_graph_max_bs
server_arguments.label: cuda-graph-max-bs
server_arguments.desc: Set the maximum batch size for cuda graph.

server_arguments.name: cuda_graph_bs
server_arguments.label: cuda-graph-bs
server_arguments.desc: Set the list of batch sizes for cuda graph.

server_arguments.name: torchao_config
server_arguments.label: torchao-config
server_arguments.desc: Optimize the model with torchao.

server_arguments.name: enable_nan_detection
server_arguments.label: enable-nan-detection
server_arguments.desc: Enable the NaN detection for debugging purposes.

server_arguments.name: enable_p2p_check
server_arguments.label: enable-p2p-check
server_arguments.desc: Enable P2P check for GPU access.

server_arguments.name: triton_attention_reduce_in_fp32
server_arguments.label: triton-attention-reduce-in-fp32
server_arguments.desc: Cast the intermidiate attention results to fp32 to avoid possible crashes.

server_arguments.name: triton_attention_num_kv_splits
server_arguments.label: triton-attention-num-kv-splits
server_arguments.desc: The number of KV splits in flash decoding Triton kernel.

server_arguments.name: num_continuous_decode_steps
server_arguments.label: num-continuous-decode-steps
server_arguments.desc: Run multiple continuous decoding steps to reduce scheduling overhead.

server_arguments.name: delete_ckpt_after_loading
server_arguments.label: delete-ckpt-after-loading
server_arguments.desc: Delete the model checkpoint after loading the model.

server_arguments.name: enable_memory_saver
server_arguments.label: enable-memory-saver
server_arguments.desc: Allow saving memory using release_memory_occupation and resume_memory_occupation

server_arguments.name: allow_auto_truncate
server_arguments.label: allow-auto-truncate
server_arguments.desc: Allow automatically truncating requests that exceed the maximum input length.

server_arguments.name: return_hidden_states
server_arguments.label: return-hidden-states
server_arguments.desc: Return hidden states in the response.

server_arguments.name: enable_custom_logit_processor
server_arguments.label: enable-custom-logit-processor
server_arguments.desc: Enable users to pass custom logit processors to the server.

server_arguments.name: tool_call_parser
server_arguments.label: tool-call-parser
server_arguments.desc: Specify the parser for handling tool-call interactions.

server_arguments.name: enable_hierarchical_cache
server_arguments.label: enable-hierarchical-cache
server_arguments.desc: Enable hierarchical cache

server_arguments.name: enable_flashinfer_mla
server_arguments.label: enable-flashinfer-mla
server_arguments.desc: Enable FlashInfer MLA optimization

arguments.name: temperature
arguments.label: temperature
arguments.desc: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic

arguments.name: top_p
arguments.label: top_p
arguments.desc: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered

arguments.name: top_k
arguments.label: top_k
arguments.desc: The number of highest probability vocabulary tokens to keep for top-k-filtering

arguments.name: max_tokens
arguments.label: max_tokens
arguments.desc: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the chat completion

arguments.name: min_tokens
arguments.label: min_tokens
arguments.desc: The minimum number of tokens to generate in the chat completion

arguments.name: stop
arguments.label: stop_sequences
arguments.desc: Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens

arguments.name: presence_penalty
arguments.label: presence_penalty
arguments.desc: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics

arguments.name: frequency_penalty
arguments.label: frequency_penalty
arguments.desc: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim

arguments.name: logit_bias
arguments.label: logit_bias
arguments.desc: Accepts a json object that maps tokens (specified by their token ID in the tokenizer) to an associated bias value from -100 to 100. Mathematically, the bias is added to the logits generated by the model prior to sampling

arguments.name: ignore_eos
arguments.label: ignore_eos
arguments.desc: Whether to ignore the EOS token and continue generating tokens after the EOS token is generated.

arguments.name: use_beam_search
arguments.label: use_beam_search
arguments.desc: Whether to use beam search instead of sampling.

arguments.name: stop_token_ids
arguments.label: stop_token_ids
arguments.desc: List of tokens that stop the generation when they are generated. The returned output will contain the stop tokens unless the stop tokens are special tokens.

arguments.name: skip_special_tokens
arguments.label: skip_special_tokens
arguments.desc: Whether to skip special tokens in the output.

arguments.name: n
arguments.label: n
arguments.desc: number of answers to generate
